title: Symmetric pointed pair (Theorem T) is reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem T (symmetric pointed pair, t3.md section 4): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with u ≠ v such that some isomorphism G − u → G − v maps v to u, the ordered pairs (x, y), x ≠ y, with G − x − y ≅ G − u − v that are not pointed-card equivalent to (u, v) are fewer than those that are, and every automorphism of G − u − v preserves G-degrees, is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (∃ κ : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = v → (κ z).1 = u) ∧ {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ Nonempty (G.induce ({p.1, p.2}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) ∧ ¬ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = v}.ncard < {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = v}.ncard ∧ ∀ g : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (G.neighborSet (g x).1).ncard = (G.neighborSet x.1).ncard)
